decisions.reason: As an SMS API closely related to the firm’s secure communication platform, supported by its own R&D and still actively presented in 2024, it fits existing capabilities and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

The email-to-SMS gateway is very close to the firm’s established multi-channel messaging business, so with strong absorptive capacity and strategic fit the firm is likely to retain it despite its recent launch.

The SMS-to-email gateway also builds directly on the firm’s existing knowledge in integrated enterprise communications, and given in-house R&D and market growth it is more likely to be kept and refined than dropped.
